posts.text: I am excited to share that I have accepted my offer admission to the HBA program at Ivey Business School at Western University. I am looking forward to continuing my education in both the aspects of business and computer science!

Had an amazing time at Western Developers Society's Case Comp. X Hackathon, Spark. Over the weekend, I had the opportunity to participate in my first case competition X Hackathon, being given a real world problem and building a working solution. Ultimately present in front of judges and winning third place 🥉 !
